<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown compound. The only way to get structural information is to request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, then count the distinct carbon signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm). Each such signal corresponds to a unique CH₃ carbon.</thought>
